test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 24 Aug 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
The pie chart given below shows the expenditure of a certain company across various sectors - P, Q, R, S, T and U - during a particular year. Study the graph and answer the question.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0e8e83ffe410d4e50647cffe59a927ea01ba21287e85cd91004c37d78d3dfacc.png] 

What approximate percentage of the total spending is spent on sector S?
solution:
**Calculation**

The total spending is spent on sector S = 95°

360° → 100%

95° → 100/360 × 95 = 26.38% ≈ 26.40%

**The answer is 26.40%**
